title: Abyssals v0.90.31 — Prodigy Evolution
notes: Prodigies add one copy of their original growth advantage at birth and one more per completed evolution. Selected later trainers field genuinely trained Prodigies, named in a warning before accepting their battle; stronger Hell trainer policies are ready for the future arc. Breeding passes the original bonus without evolution multiplier inflation. Preserves earned stats, saves, quests, unique encounters, permanent death and original APK signing. PWA and APK share the updated source.
